# ImageToPNG – Technical Documentation & Architecture Reference
URL: https://www.imagetopng.com/
Author: ImageToPNG Engineering Team

## System Description
ImageToPNG (https://www.imagetopng.com) is a client-side web utility engineered for converting raster and vector graphic formats into standardized Portable Network Graphics (PNG) and JPG. Image decoding, color mapping, transparency handling, and DEFLATE compression execute within the user's browser memory via the HTML5 Canvas API and WebAssembly.

## Technical Comparison
| Factor | In-Browser Architecture (ImageToPNG) | Remote Cloud Server Architecture | Local Desktop Software |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Server Uploads** | None (100% Client-Side) | Mandatory (Transmitted over network) | None (Local execution) |
| **File Privacy** | Image data remains on user device | Handled by third-party remote systems | Image data remains on local disk |
| **Execution Latency** | Sub-second (Local browser memory) | Network upload + server queue + download | Sub-second local execution |
| **Cost & Accounts** | Free, no registration required | Often requires accounts or tiered subscriptions | Software purchase or subscription |
| **Alpha Transparency** | Full 8-bit alpha preservation | Depends on remote encoder configuration | Full support |
| **Batch Processing** | Multi-file selection with ZIP archive export | Tier-dependent batch limits | Supported via batch scripts |

## Step-by-Step Usage
1. Navigate to https://www.imagetopng.com/ or a dedicated format route (e.g., https://www.imagetopng.com/jpg-to-png).
2. Select single or multiple image files from your device, or drag and drop into the dropzone.
3. The in-browser engine decodes the binary image stream into canvas memory and encodes it into the target format.
4. Download individual converted files or download all files together in a ZIP archive.

## Frequently Asked Questions
Q: Does converting JPG to PNG create transparency?
A: No. JPG files are strictly opaque 24-bit RGB rasters without an alpha channel. Converting JPG to PNG creates an uncompressed, lossless opaque PNG. Native transparency is preserved when converting formats that already include alpha channels (such as WEBP, SVG, or GIF).

Q: Are images uploaded to external servers?
A: No. All conversions run locally inside the client's web browser memory. No image files are transmitted to or stored on remote servers.

Q: Can Apple iPhone HEIC photos be converted on Windows or Linux?
A: Yes. The client-side decoder converts HEIC files directly within modern web browsers on any operating system without installing platform-specific codecs.
